{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge crew-neck knit, regular fit, hip length, warm cream (#EDE3D1), merino wool blend
Straight-leg trousers, mid-rise, full ankle length, charcoal grey (#4A4D52), wool-blend suiting fabric
Textured blazer, single-breasted, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, taupe-brown herringbone (#8A7A68), wool tweed
Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, deep chocolate brown (#4B3326), polished leather
Belt, slim, simple gold-tone buckle, chocolate brown (#4B3326), smooth leather
Tote bag, structured, medium size, cognac (#9A5B32), grained leather
Thin scarf, loosely draped, muted olive (#6E6B4A), light wool

This outfit sits right in the neat business band: a refined knit with tailored trousers, a textured jacket and loafers are exactly what a workday in autumn calls for. The blazer in tweed serves as the outer layer, adding warmth for cool autumn mornings while still looking polished at the desk. The warm neutrals of cream, taupe and chocolate are calm and cohesive, and the olive scarf and cognac bag add quiet depth without being loud. Every piece is comfortable enough for a full day of work and easy to mix with the rest of a wardrobe."}
